other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Cogeneration system listed among energy-saving proposals but rejected by the committee; not deployed
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Numerous energy saving programs and suggestions, such as wind 
power generation, biomass energy, and cogeneration system, did not pass the review for adoption by 
the promotion committee

one_line: Case study of implementing an ISO 50001 energy management system at a discrete-manufacturing electronics parts/components company in Guangdong, China, using an "integration-energy-practice" model to improve energy performance indicators.
